mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5%, persistent inflation triggers aggressive monetary tightening that depresses equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where CPIAUCSL YoY change exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Strong labor market growth (PAYEMS > 0.5% MoM) combined with high policy rates (FEDFUNDS > 1.0%) signals overheating economy triggering aggressive tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where PAYEMS growth > 0.5% MoM and FEDFUNDS > 1.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Housing market recovery (HOUST growth > 1.0% MoM) signals strengthening consumer spending and business investment, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where HOUST growth exceeds 1.0% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: Declining unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates tightening labor market conditions that precede stronger corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where UNRATE has declined for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production contraction (INDPRO growth < -0.5% MoM) signals economic slowdown that triggers equity sell-off, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where INDPRO growth is below -0.5% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: Strong GDP growth (GDPC1 quarterly growth > 2.0%) combined with weak industrial production (INDPRO growth < 0.0% MoM) indicates demand-supply mismatch triggering recession fears, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where GDPC1 growth > 2.0% and INDPRO growth < 0.0% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: Monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising > 0.25% in 3 months) depresses equity valuations through higher discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS has risen by more than 0.25% over 3 months.
